limitations.note: The patch fixed the shift direction but replaced the registered comparison with a combinational one, making match assert and deassert one clock earlier than in the expected design.
The test checked match against the post-shift state, so it validated the new timing rather than detecting that the original output was based on the pre-shift state.
The knowledge-base search surfaced related 9-bit detector examples, but the record shows no finding from them that informed the match-timing decision.
